runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Existing LIVE items are never removed merely because a discovery run does not rediscover them.
runSummary.note: Real 14.9.2026 17:22 sweep across 12 source families: Profesia, direct company careers/public ATS, LinkedIn public jobs indexing, Worki, Kariera/Zoznam, Brigada.sk, Služby zamestnanosti, Pretlak/StartupJobs, Upwork freelance discovery, Reddit/WordPress communities and publicly indexed Facebook groups. No safe LIVE promotion was written because the connector cannot round-trip the complete 56-item jobs-data.json without truncation. A new Upwork computer-equipment product-listing role is functionally very close and has only 5-10 proposals, but strong written English is explicit and effective fixed-price economics still need validation before promotion. Facebook produced 0 verified direct-post hits. No LIVE deletion was performed.

developmentChanges.title: Fixed-price scope normalizer
developmentChanges.reason: For freelance product-listing jobs, estimate expected items/hours from stated scope before ranking fixed budgets. This prevents attractive WooCommerce keywords from hiding weak effective hourly pay.

developmentChanges.title: Written-English task risk score
developmentChanges.reason: Separate spoken-English requirements from written-English execution risk. Product research, SEO descriptions and client messaging can require materially stronger English even when no formal B2/C1 level is stated.
